educational_overlay.purpose: Generates structured tabular schedules extracting material clauses across dozens of contracts during M&A or financing diligence.
educational_overlay.when_to_use: During virtual data room (VDR) contract reviews for mergers, debt financing, or private equity investments.
educational_overlay.when_not_to_use: When reviewing an isolated single-page side letter.

variables.label: Target Diligence Clauses
variables.default: Change of Control, Exclusivity, Assignment, Non-Compete, Governing Law

educational_overlay.prompt_template:
Perform tabular due diligence review on uploaded contract batch for contracts exceeding {{MATERIALITY_THRESHOLD}}.
Extract and tabulate: {{EXTRACT_FIELDS}}.
Flag any change-of-control provisions requiring counterparty consent prior to equity transfer.
Highlight unusual indemnity obligations or unilateral termination rights.
educational_overlay.fictional_scenario: In a proposed acquisition of an edtech startup, legal counsel must review 45 vendor and customer agreements in 48 hours.
educational_overlay.sample_output:
### Diligence Extraction Schedule
| Doc ID | Counterparty | Expiry Date | Change of Control? | Assignment Restriction? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C-01 | AWS Cloud | 12/2027 | No | Consent Required |
| C-02 | Payment Gateway | 04/2026 | Yes (30d notice) | Prohibited |
guardrails: Confirm whether unsigned agreements in VDR were actually executed in practice.
verification_checklist: Verify stamp duty payment on material contracts.
Check registration status where mandatory under Registration Act 1908.
educational_overlay.ai_risk_warning: AI can miss cross-references to exhibits stored in separate VDR folders.
